mapper.select: SELECT aar.attr_id FROM pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar INNER JOIN pms_attr_group ag ON aar.attr_group_id = ag.attr_group_id WHERE ag.catelog_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT aar.id, aar.attr_id, aar.attr_group_id, aar.attr_sort, pa.attr_name, pag.attr_group_name FROM pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar LEFT JOIN pms_attr pa ON pa.attr_id = aar.attr_id LEFT JOIN pms_attr_group pag ON pag.attr_group_id = aar.attr_group_id WHERE aar.attr_group_id = #{attrGroupId} ORDER BY aar.attr_sort ASC
